purpose: Express an informal wondering or uncertainty.
keywords: I wonder whether it will rain tomorrow.
I wonder whether this is the right road.
I wonder what I should make.
restrictions: Often self-directed; use a more explicit polite question when addressing strangers.
mistake: Nouns do not take plain だ immediately before かな.

segments.role: Express an informal wondering or uncertainty. Plain clause + かな.

examples.translation: I wonder whether it will rain tomorrow.
